name: Redmi Pad SE (8 GB)
evidence: adb 37.0.1 over USB, 2026-11-01: pm list packages, getprop, dumpsys, dumpsys gfxinfo. Labels checked with aapt2 on APKs pulled from the device. The raw measurement is not published: it contains the owner's app list.

MIUI telemetry: usage statistics sent to Xiaomi
'System quality monitoring' (APK label): collects device statistics
system bug reporting; nothing in daily use depends on it
Mi Browser; the owner uses Firefox and Chrome
Mi Video, a player with promos and ads; videos open in another app
Mi Music; music plays in another app
Discover: Xiaomi's app recommendations and storefront
'Third party app problems' (APK label): warnings and suggestions to uninstall third-party apps
DeviceInfoQR: a QR code with the device's data, only for service desks

ODM Longcheer's factory self-test
CIT, ODM Longcheer's factory integration test
virtual SIM: the device is Wi-Fi only, no modem
FM radio: the tablet has no radio
FM radio service, with no hardware to serve
'Link to Windows' bridge, preinstalled, unused here
cleaner with ads, but Settings > Storage may open into it: measure before removing
Mi file manager with recommendations; Google Files is already installed, but some system flows open into it
'Mi Services' (support/after-sales); the effect of turning it off was not measured
MIUI daemon; debloat lists turn it off, but the effect on HyperOS 2 was not measured
